config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.resp]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_missing = "reject"


[[models]]
name = "m-resp-sess"
provider = "resp"
model = "m-up"
name: m4_session_missing_reject_responses
